items.t: Pre-catalyst breaks apart and scores the cylinders
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold with built-in pre-catalyst
items.note: Parts: Dorman 674-659 manifold-converter about $509; Nissan 14002-8J006/8J008 about $949. No published labor time found, so hours are backed out from YourMechanic's 2006 Sentra 2.5L estimate ($1,406; shops $1,728-$2,656). If debris already scored the cylinders, a used engine or rebuild costs much more. RepairPal (all Sentras): $2,561-$2,651.

items.t: CVT whine, shudder or slipping
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Parts: SP Precision remanufactured CVT listed for 2007-and-newer Sentra at $3,795 plus core. No 2007-2012 labor time found; hours use Jerry's 2015 Sentra labor figure ($1,400-$1,500) as the basis. A used CVT costs less. A fluid change may help a mild case.

items.t: CVT shudder, hesitation and failure
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Parts: Jerry lists $3,150-$3,400 for a 2015 Sentra; SP Precision remanufactured CVT $3,795 plus core. Hours backed out from Jerry's $1,400-$1,500 labor figure (no published labor time found). Jerry total: $4,550-$4,900. CarComplaints owners report about $3,700 typical. A used CVT costs less; a software update or fluid change fixes some mild cases.
